result:
**Not ready to publish.** Three things need changing.

**Product label**
- The draft doesn't say whether Pebblebrook is Owned, Tried or Wishlist, and I can't assume it.
- "I've tried four tea subscriptions this year", "easiest to pause" and "the tins are lovely" are all hands-on claims. They're only allowed if the writer actually used the subscription.
- Please confirm the label. If Owned or Tried, say how long and how (for example, "I subscribed for three months"). If Wishlist, cut the hands-on claims and use only sourced facts.

**Superlative: "easiest to pause"**
- This is a comparison against the other three subscriptions, and nothing in the draft backs it up.
- The brand can say that subscribers can pause or cancel any time.
- If the writer really did pause it, describe what happened instead, for example: "I paused in two clicks from my account page." Only write that if it's true.

**Affiliate disclosure**
- The disclosure must come at the top of the post, before the first link, in plain words. "(Affiliate link)" after the link doesn't meet that.
- Suggested opener: "This post contains affiliate links. If you buy through them, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you."
- Also say whether the product was gifted or sponsored. If it was, label that where Pebblebrook first appears.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "tried four tea subscriptions this year" | Unverified hands-on claim, needs writer confirmation |
| "easiest to pause" | Unsupported comparison |
| "tins are lovely" | Opinion, fine only if Owned or Tried |
| "affiliate link" | Present but wrongly placed |

**Compliant version, pending the writer's confirmation**

> This post contains affiliate links. If you buy through them, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
>
> I tried Pebblebrook's subscription for [PROOF NEEDED: how long]. Pausing took [PROOF NEEDED: what the writer actually did], and subscribers can pause or cancel any time. The tins are [PROOF NEEDED: writer's real description, only if owned]. [Link] (affiliate)
